members.reason: [llm] duplicates #3221: Concurrent/duplicate JSON-RPC request ids in the same StreamableHTTP session are not rejected, so a second in-flight request reusing an id overwrites the first's slot in `_request_streams`, cross-wiring the two responses (one request gets the other's payload, the other hangs).

members.author: arimu1

(2 PRs)
members.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: Concurrent/duplicate JSON-RPC request ids in the same StreamableHTTP session are not rejected, so a second in-flight request reusing an id overwrites the first's slot in `_request_streams`, cross-wiring the two responses (one request gets the other's payload, the other hangs). (2 PRs)
members.cluster_pick_reason: Both PRs add the same in-flight duplicate-id rejection in `_handle_post_request`, but #3063 keys `_request_streams` with plain `str(message.id)`, which collapses JSON-RPC ids that are distinct per spec (integer `1` and string `"1"` map to the same key), so it can produce false-positive 409s or still cross-wire responses between an int and string id pair. It also doesn't guard against a string id equal to `_GET_stream` colliding with the reserved `GET_STREAM_KEY` slot. #3221 replaces the raw key with a type-preserving `_request_stream_key()` (`i:`/`s:` prefixes) that fixes both edge cases while implementing the identical duplicate-rejection behavior, so it's a strict superset of #3063's fix.

clusters.pick_reason: Both PRs add the same in-flight duplicate-id rejection in `_handle_post_request`, but #3063 keys `_request_streams` with plain `str(message.id)`, which collapses JSON-RPC ids that are distinct per spec (integer `1` and string `"1"` map to the same key), so it can produce false-positive 409s or still cross-wire responses between an int and string id pair. It also doesn't guard against a string id equal to `_GET_stream` colliding with the reserved `GET_STREAM_KEY` slot. #3221 replaces the raw key with a type-preserving `_request_stream_key()` (`i:`/`s:` prefixes) that fixes both edge cases while implementing the identical duplicate-rejection behavior, so it's a strict superset of #3063's fix.
